<title Refreshes [G_refresh] /> held weapon after sprinting for 1.5 seconds.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25%
Increases Slide Distance by 33%
Crouch Speed is set to 4 metres per second and cannot be decreased through slows debuffs.

<title Refills [G_refill] /> held weapon from reserves after sprinting for 1.5 seconds.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.

Crouch Speed is set to 4 meters per second and bypasses slowing effects.

<title Refills [G_refill] /> held weapon from reserves after sprinting for 1.5 seconds.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.

Prevents Crouch Speed from being decreased below 4 meters per second.
